newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Foreign trade in S.African gilts rises in March.
newsitem.headline: Foreign trade in S.African gilts rises in March.

text.p: Non-resident trades on South Africa's Bond Exchange accounted for nearly a quarter of total turnover in March and were net buyers of a record amount of domestic gilts in the month.
Latest data provided by the exchange shows non-resident trades accounted for 22 percent of total market volume of 282.77 billion rand.

Total net foreign purchases of bonds during the month amounted to 2.872 billion rand bringing total net purchases for the first three months of the year to 6.09 billion rand -- a 1,587 percent increase on the same period last year.
An exchange official said foreign net purchases in March were the highest since it began reporting trades in June 1995.
Offshore trades directly between non-residents rose 20 percent month-on-month to 59.52 billion rand in March, bringing cumulative total trades to 136.3 billion rand.
Repurchase transactions accounted for 52 per cent of total turnover, up from 43 percent in February.
